issues.t: Falcon wing doors stop, won't open or hit objects
issues.sym: The rear falcon wing doors stop partway, refuse to open because they 'see' an obstacle that isn't there, close unevenly, or fail to notice a garage beam or door opener and hit it, sometimes cracking the glass.
issues.why: The doors rely on ultrasonic and capacitive sensors to judge clearance. The sensors give false readings in heat or come loose, and software early on was not reliable; hinges and latches also need adjustment.
issues.next: Watch the doors when opening them in a garage until you trust them, and set the door opening height in the settings. Ask for a software update, sensor check and door alignment.

issues.t: Front doors won't open, close or latch
issues.sym: The automatic front doors won't open, won't close all the way, open and close by themselves, or the car says a door is open when it is shut.
issues.why: The front door latches and the motors that power the doors fail. Tesla later fitted updated latches to many cars.
issues.next: Use the manual release if a door won't open. Have the latches checked and ask whether your car has the updated latch parts.

issues.t: Shudder or vibration from front half-shafts
issues.sym: A shudder, vibration or rattle when accelerating hard, often felt through the floor, sometimes with a clicking or grinding noise from the front.
issues.why: The front axle shafts (half-shafts) that carry power from the front motor wear or are out of balance. Many were replaced more than once before a revised part arrived.
issues.next: Have the front half-shafts and their mounts inspected. Ask for the newest version of the part if they are replaced.

issues.t: Air suspension won't inflate or sags
issues.sym: The SUV sits low at one corner or the front, a suspension warning appears, the compressor clicks or runs constantly, or the ride height won't change.
issues.why: Air struts leak and the compressor wears out from running too often. A blown fuse or failed compressor can stop the whole system.
issues.next: Don't drive far with a corner sitting on its stops. Have a leak test done so a leaking strut doesn't take the compressor with it.

issues.t: A/C stops cooling
issues.sym: Air from the vents turns warm, the A/C works only some of the time, or the compressor gets loud.
issues.why: The A/C compressor fails on some cars, and others have a leaking O-ring, condenser or a bad evaporator temperature sensor.
issues.next: Have the system tested for leaks and sensor faults first, which is simpler. A loud compressor should be checked before it fails and spreads debris.

issues.t: Touchscreen goes blank from worn memory chip (recall 21V-035)
issues.sym: The center screen reboots, freezes or goes black, and you may lose the backup camera and defrost controls.
issues.why: The flash memory chip in the media computer (MCU1) wears out from constant writing.
issues.next: Check your VIN for the recall. Tesla replaces the memory board for free.

issues.t: Center screen freezes or goes black
issues.sym: The screens crash, stay black at startup, lose navigation, or reboot while driving.
issues.why: Besides the memory chip covered by the recall, the media computer itself or its navigation memory can fail.
issues.next: Try a screen reboot by holding both steering wheel scroll buttons. If it keeps happening, ask about replacement or an upgrade to the newer MCU2 computer.

issues.t: 12-volt battery fails
issues.sym: A low-voltage warning, a car that won't wake up or won't go into drive, or the doors not responding.
issues.why: The small 12-volt battery that powers the computers and doors wears out after a few years.
issues.next: Replace it promptly when the warning appears. Tesla mobile service can often do it at home.

issues.t: Front control arms squeak or links break
issues.sym: Squeaks or creaks from the front over bumps, a clunk, or in rare cases a broken link that changes how the car steers.
issues.why: The front upper control arms and the lower aft links wear out on this heavy SUV.
issues.next: Have the front suspension inspected at the first sign of noise; a broken link can damage nearby parts.

issues.t: Wind noise from doors and window seals
issues.sym: Whistling or roaring at highway speed, often from a front window or around the falcon wing doors.
issues.why: Door glass and seals go out of alignment, and some seals come loose.
issues.next: Ask for window recalibration and seal adjustment. Recalibrating may also be needed after window tinting.

issues.t: Windshield shows double images
issues.sym: Lights and objects look doubled or ghosted through the large panoramic windshield, especially at night.
issues.why: Some early windshields had optical distortion.
issues.next: Compare the view with another Model X if you can. A replacement windshield is the only fix.

issues.t: Battery coolant leak
issues.sym: A low coolant warning, coolant drips under the car, or a sweet smell.
issues.why: A fitting or hose in the battery and drive unit cooling loop can leak.
issues.next: Have it repaired promptly; the battery depends on coolant to stay at a safe temperature.

issues.t: Third-row seat back may fold forward in a crash (recall 16V-192)
issues.sym: No symptom you can see.
issues.why: The third-row seat back could move forward in a frontal crash.
issues.next: Check your VIN; Tesla replaces the seats for free.

issues.t: Parking brake may not release or hold (recall 17V-260)
issues.sym: The parking brake won't release, or it won't stay on.
issues.why: A small gear in the electric parking brake caliper can break.
issues.next: Check your VIN. Tesla replaces both rear parking brake calipers for free.

issues.t: Second-row seat may not latch (recall 17V-639)
issues.sym: The left second-row seat back doesn't lock firmly into place.
issues.why: The recliner cable may be out of adjustment so the seat back doesn't fully latch.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the cable adjusted for free.

issues.t: Power steering bolts can corrode and break (recall 20V-062)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly becomes much heavier, especially at low speed.
issues.why: Aluminum bolts on the power steering motor can corrode and break, mostly in cold, salted-road areas.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Check your VIN; Tesla replaces the bolts or the steering gear for free.

issues.t: Roof trim can come off while driving (recalls 20V-710, 24V-615)
issues.sym: The roof trim strip lifts, flaps or detaches at speed.
issues.why: Adhesive holding the roof trim may not have been applied with primer and can let go.
issues.next: Check your VIN; Tesla tests the adhesion and reattaches the trim for free.

issues.t: Power steering assist may cut out on rough roads (recall 22V-818)
issues.sym: Steering suddenly feels heavy after a pothole or rough patch.
issues.why: Power steering software could misread a sudden current spike and turn off assist.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. Make sure your software is up to date; the fix is an over-the-air update.

issues.t: False collision warnings and sudden braking (recall 21V-846)
issues.sym: A forward collision warning or hard automatic braking with nothing ahead.
issues.why: A software communication error could trigger false warnings or emergency braking.
issues.next: Install the latest update and report any repeat events to Tesla.

issues.t: Backup camera image slow to appear (recall 22V-169)
issues.sym: The rearview image is delayed or missing when you shift into reverse.
issues.why: A software problem could delay the camera feed.
issues.next: Install the latest update and look over your shoulder until the image appears.

issues.t: Autosteer may not keep the driver engaged (recall 23V-838)
issues.sym: Autosteer can stay on even if you look away or don't hold the wheel enough.
issues.why: Driver monitoring checks were judged too weak to prevent misuse of Autosteer.
issues.next: Install the update, and always keep hands on the wheel and eyes on the road with Autopilot.

issues.t: Boombox can drown out pedestrian warning sound (recall 22V-235)
issues.sym: Sounds played through the external speaker while moving.
issues.why: The Boombox feature could mask the low-speed pedestrian warning sound.
issues.next: Install the update, which disables Boombox while the car is in drive, neutral or reverse.

issues.t: Windshield defrost weak in cold weather (recall 22V-050)
issues.sym: Cabin heat and windshield defrost fade on cold days.
issues.why: A software fault could trap refrigerant in the heat pump's evaporator.
issues.next: Install the update. Stop driving if fog or ice blocks your view.

issues.t: Side curtain airbags may not deploy properly (recall 22V-233)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: The front side curtain airbags may not deploy correctly when the windows are down.
issues.next: Check your VIN and book the free airbag replacement.

issues.t: Touchscreen lags or reboots while fast charging (recall 22V-296)
issues.sym: The center screen becomes slow or restarts during or after Supercharging.
issues.why: The computer's processor could overheat while fast charging.
issues.next: Install the over-the-air update.

issues.t: Second-row seat bracket may be missing (recall 22V-264)
issues.sym: No symptom you can see.
issues.why: A body reinforcement bracket at the second-row seat may be missing, weakening crash protection.
issues.next: Check your VIN right away; Tesla replaced affected vehicles.

issues.t: Passenger airbag may deploy wrongly in low-speed crash (recall 22V-843)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: The front passenger airbag could deploy in a way that raises injury risk in some low-speed crashes.
issues.next: Install the over-the-air recalibration.

issues.t: Low brake fluid may not trigger warning (recall 23V-679)
issues.sym: No brake fluid warning even when the level is low.
issues.why: Software may not show the low brake fluid warning light.
issues.next: Install the update and have the brake fluid level checked if braking feels soft.

issues.t: Front seat belts may detach from anchor (recall 23V-488)
issues.sym: No symptom you can see.
issues.why: The front belts may not be properly attached to the lap pretensioner anchors.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the belts inspected for free.

issues.t: Doors may unlock during a crash (recall 23V-862)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: Software could unlock the cabin doors in a crash, raising the chance a door opens.
issues.next: Install the over-the-air update.

issues.t: Hood may not warn when unlatched (recall 24V-554)
issues.sym: No alert appears even though the front trunk isn't fully closed.
issues.why: The hood latch switch may not detect an open hood.
issues.next: Install the update and press the frunk lid down firmly before driving.

issues.t: Driver airbag may tear when it deploys (recall 24V-967)
issues.sym: No symptom in normal driving.
issues.why: The driver airbag cushion may tear during deployment.
issues.next: Check your VIN and have the driver airbag replaced for free.

issues.t: Horn may not sound from wrong horn pad (recall 25V-172)
issues.sym: Pressing the horn pad doesn't sound the horn.
issues.why: An incorrect horn pad may have been fitted with the driver airbag.
issues.next: Test the horn and check your VIN for the recall.

issues.t: Backup camera lost from a computer board short (recall 25V-002)
issues.sym: The rearview camera image disappears.
issues.why: A circuit board in the car's computer can short-circuit.
issues.next: Check your VIN; Tesla updates the software and replaces the computer if needed.

issues.t: Rearview image lag or missing (recalls 23V-244, 24V-035, 26V-283)
issues.sym: The backup camera picture freezes, lags or doesn't appear in reverse.
issues.why: Weak camera signal or software instability could delay or block the camera feed.
issues.next: Install the latest update and check behind you before backing up.
